facts.fact: The OBS-CC observatory states that law no. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 opened an 18-month transition and that its obligations, including breach notification, have been enforceable since 23 June 2026.
The OBS-CC observatory states that the APDP created by the law is not yet installed.
The OBS-CC observatory states that the implementing decree provided by article 53 of the law has not been taken.
